system.label: Fruit-juice line
system.description: Receive and extract fruit, clarify the juice, optionally concentrate, blend and package. A separate solar/battery utility illustrates power availability.

Product holding vessel → Final polishing
Final polishing → Juice filling
Juice filling → Case packing

Demonstration battery buffer → Fruit receiving belt
Demonstration battery buffer → Fruit extraction crusher
Demonstration battery buffer → Juice clarification
Demonstration battery buffer → Illustrative concentration stage
Demonstration battery buffer → Juice blending vessel

Demonstration battery buffer → Blend inventory monitor

Blend inventory monitor → Juice-line operator panel
